Name: Move More
Author: viksra
Description: Select several keys at once and move them together: within a page, or between pages and folders shown side by side. Also search keys, zoom, and add, reorder or delete pages. Opens a layout editor in your browser; Stream Deck restarts to load the new layout and a backup is kept for every change.

Actions.Name: Layout Editor
Actions.Tooltip: Opens the Move More layout editor, where you can select several keys and move them at once.
